name: fapnado.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.fapnado.com scores 69 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /latest-updates/, /top-rated/, /most-popular/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 7 elements on /, /latest-updates/, for example a[data-open="signup"] and a[href$="partnership.php"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /latest-updates/, for example button[aria-label="Select genders"] and button[aria-label="Expand"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: PHPSESSID. Without HttpOnly: PHPSESSID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /latest-updates/, /top-rated/ and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies nauid on www.csicskalangos.com, _ga_QPXS19GHH7, _ga, __uvt on magsrv.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 238 ms
Every page has a meta description
